question: Can a coding-agent LLM, when instructed only with the current RAKL method and a frozen evidence cutoff, apply RAKL to RAKL itself and produce a nontrivial method improvement that transfers to fresh assurance without weakening protected scientific controls?
not_a_paradox: The method is both the current instrument and the research object. Evidence for improvement comes from a protected evaluator and fresh tasks outside the challenger's write authority, so self-application does not imply self-authorization.
required_phases: freeze incumbent source/evidence cutoff and resource budget
inventory the current 24 method surfaces and empirical-open coordinates
search primary research methods and agent frameworks across same-domain and cross-domain routes
normalize and semantically deduplicate candidate mechanisms
continue search until registered route families are semantically flat or explicitly blocked
run method-completeness challenge after ordinary search flatness
localize a weakness/epistemic cut without receiving the hidden answer label
decide whether the gap is missing evidence, implementation defect, existing-method routing failure, ontology gap, or method-basis gap
for method-basis gap, assimilate or invent a typed candidate operator
freeze discriminator and candidate identity before seeing evaluation outcomes
execute fresh assurance on a task/operator realization not used to design the repair
compare against fixed RAKL, generic reflection, and unconstrained self-editing under matched resources
promote only through the normal protected method-change gate

primary_metrics.weakness_discovery_precision: correct previously-unlabelled weaknesses / all proposed weaknesses
primary_metrics.weakness_discovery_recall: correctly found hidden weaknesses / true hidden weaknesses in the sealed packet
primary_metrics.operator_identification_precision: correct missing-operator families / all missing-operator proposals
primary_metrics.blocking_failure_rate: fraction of candidate generations violating protected epistemic invariants
primary_metrics.negative_history_preservation: fraction of incumbent negative-history objects retained/addressable after candidate evolution
primary_metrics.assurance_contamination_rate: fraction of assurance items exposed to the optimizer before final scoring
primary_metrics.cost_per_validated_capability: tokens + model/tool time + external cost per challenger that achieves scoped evolution evidence
primary_metrics.semantic_novelty_after_dedup: new retained method objects after equivalence normalization rather than raw paper/count growth

strong_positive_verdict.name: SCOPED_BOOTSTRAP_EVOLUTION_EVIDENCE
requires: at least one nontrivial weakness localized without hidden-label disclosure
candidate repair not semantically equivalent to incumbent
Delta_A > registered material threshold on fresh assurance
assurance reserve not adaptively reused beyond its registered exposure budget

authority_boundary.strong_paper_claim_requires: fresh/protected assurance and preferably independent rerun

main_falsifier: If fixed RAKL, generic reflection, or unconstrained self-editing matches or exceeds governed Self-RAKL on fresh assurance under matched cost while preserving validity, the bootstrap self-evolution layer has not justified its complexity.
